cards.front: Is 3/4 × 20 more or less than 20? Why?
Is 5/4 × 20 more or less than 20? Why?
Does multiplying always make a number bigger?
cards.back: No. Multiplying by a number less than 1 makes it smaller.
4/4 = 1, and multiplying by 1 keeps the value the same.
